fieldNotes.location: Confirmed UNFI Howell NJ DC, 433 Oak Glen Rd, Howell NJ 07731. Roster ROOFTOP geocode 40.139697,-74.187949 lands squarely on a large distribution building with near-full rooftop solar coverage in a heavily wooded parcel off Oak Glen Rd, Monmouth County NJ. Web-corroborated: BBB / Panjiva / NJ BPU filing / Yellow Pages - a 385,000 sq ft UNFI natural/organic specialty DC; the NJ BPU filing documents two rooftop solar arrays (1.575 MW Project A + 1.652 MW Project B), matching the solar-covered roof in imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingShape: Main DC building has near-full rooftop solar; a separate older building cluster (a red-roofed structure plus a long warehouse) sits immediately N of the main building, and an office building is near the S employee parking lot -> buildingCount 3, multipleFacilities true (multiple distinct buildings on the campus parcel).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock-door rhythm along the W face of the main building with ~50 trailers backed in/parked across the W apron and the N building's docks -> band 50+ (estimated ~55 positions; legacy-UNFI natural/organic DC of modest 385k sq ft footprint).
fieldNotes.dropYard: A modest trailer-parking area sits along the W side / NW of the main building holding parked trailers -> dropYard true, dropArea band 10-25 (smaller drop capacity than UNFI's large conventional-grocery DCs).
fieldNotes.truckGate: A single private access driveway serves the property from Oak Glen Rd; the truck circulation wraps to the W dock apron and N building. Street View on Oak Glen Rd (2025-09) shows only dense woods - the property is heavily tree-screened and set well back, so the gate is not visible at road level. A controlled gated entrance with a staffed booth is assumed for a UNFI specialty DC -> truckGate true, guardShack true, remoteGs false; all flagged medium-confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is concentrated on the W face of the main building as one continuous system; the N building's docks are an ancillary cluster rather than a distinct ship-vs-rcv split -> false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long wooded approach driveway from Oak Glen Rd into the property -> drivewayLong true.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Modest-scale specialty DC with a single access drive and limited gate apron width -> fastLaneOpportunity false (flagged, gate not directly observed).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Howell Township, Monmouth County NJ sits within the dense NYC/NJ metropolitan corridor -> Urban per the 'broader setting' rule. The immediate parcel is unusually isolated in pine-barren woods, so the call is flagged; cellular coverage in metro NJ is good -> connectivityIssue false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the E edge of the property but no spur enters; the building's E face carries solar panels, not a rail dock -> railServed false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~42 acres derived from the perimeter box around the three buildings, W dock apron, drop yard, parking, and the on-site stormwater ponds.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: Estimated 1/1 for a modest single-drive specialty DC; gate not directly observed.

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Howell Township, New Jersey as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
